requirement.title: Unix socket server
requirement.description: gmux listens on /tmp/gmux.sock for incoming push events. Protocol is JSON-line: one JSON object per line, newline-delimited. Server adds timestamp on receipt if not provided.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given gmux starts successfully, when startup completes, then /tmp/gmux.sock exists and accepts connections.
Given a client sends a valid JSON line to the socket, when the server receives it, then the event is parsed and forwarded to SessionStore.
Given a client sends malformed JSON, when the server receives it, then the line is logged as a warning and discarded. The socket remains open.
Given a client sends a partial line (no trailing newline), when more data arrives, then the server buffers until a complete line is received.

requirement.title: Event types and schema
requirement.description: Three event types with a flat structure. Required fields: event, session, pane. Additional fields depend on event type.

event_type.name: status
event_type.description: Override heuristic status for a pane.

event_type.name: notify
event_type.description: Push a notification to the dashboard feed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a "status" event with status "idle" for arcforge:1.1, when SessionStore processes it, then the status override for arcforge:1.1 is set to "idle" and takes priority over heuristics.
Given a "notify" event with message "Plan complete", when SessionStore processes it, then a new entry appears in the notification feed with the message and current timestamp.
Given a "meta" event with model and context_pct, when SessionStore processes it, then the detail panel for that session reflects the updated model and context percentage.
Given an event with an unknown event type, when the server processes it, then the event is logged as a warning and discarded.
Given an event missing a required field (event, session, or pane), when the server validates it, then the event is rejected and logged as a warning.

requirement.title: Hook scripts fail silently when gmux is not running
requirement.description: Example hook scripts shipped with gmux check for socket existence before writing. If /tmp/gmux.sock does not exist, the hook exits 0 (success) without error — fire and forget.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given /tmp/gmux.sock does not exist, when a hook script runs, then it exits with code 0 and produces no stderr output.
Given /tmp/gmux.sock exists and gmux is running, when a hook script runs, then it sends the event and exits with code 0.
